description: Alpha Fit Club is a coach-led, high-energy strength and conditioning franchise founded in 2018 in Westfield, New Jersey, and franchising since 2020 through Alpha Fit Club Franchise Company, LLC. Its studios run 60-minute circuit-style group classes blending strength training with HIIT cardio across 24- or 36-person class formats, paired with a structured 13-week training cycle and an internal Alpha-certification for every coach. The FDD (issued May 28, 2025) lists a $55,000 per-studio initial franchise fee with a two-studio minimum, total initial investment of $535,450 to $707,450 per studio, an 8% royalty, a 1% brand development fund, and a 1% local marketing requirement. Item 19 reports 2024 average gross sales of $1,020,129 across 3 company-owned studios (n=3, unaudited). Item 20 shows 13 total studios at year-end 2024 (10 franchised, 3 company-owned), all in New Jersey, with zero closures or terminations across 2022-2024 and 29 new studios projected across five East Coast states.

theory_risk_score.source: theoretical: composite risk (higher=riskier). Inputs: no litigation (10), no bankruptcy (10), zero terminations/closures 2022-2024 (5; Exhibit G: one 2024 departure — Bean Fitness, signed agreement never opened), Item-19 company-owned data only n=3 (60), young franchising history since 2020 (65), fee burden 10% + $850/mo (70), revenue trend not provided (50). Weighted mean = 10x.15 + 10x.10 + 5x.15 + 60x.20 + 65x.15 + 70x.15 + 50x.10 = 40.5. Confidence: MODERATE-WEAK (Item 19 covers company-owned only, n=3).
